title: Add intermediate milestone checkpoints
description:
Require the agent to call milestone_complete at key phases: (1) codebase exploration complete, (2) implementation plan approved, (3) code changes made, (4) tests passing. This creates natural stopping points and prevents agents from getting stuck in endless exploration loops.

Source: auto-review of attempt on TRADE-20
